tools.name: search_restaurants
tools.description: Find nearby restaurants by proximity to a set of coordinates, across ALL Olo App–enabled brands. Returns slim per-restaurant summaries (each with its ID). With the Olo Network key, OMIT channelId to search every enabled brand (cross-brand discovery); pass channelId only to narrow to a single brand. Only Olo App–participating vendors are returned, so an empty list means no enabled vendor is in range — not that a channel is missing. Each result is a slim summary (id, name, brand, distance, availability, address, handoff modes, telephone, url); check `isavailable` for whether it can currently take orders. Pass verbose:true for full untouched restaurant objects, or call get_restaurant for one vendor's full details.

radius.description: Search radius in miles (default 15). Ignored when handoffMode is "delivery".

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 10).

handoffMode.description: Order type. "delivery" restricts results to restaurants offering in-house delivery within range of the coordinates; "pickup"/"dispatch" return all nearby restaurants.

verbose.description: Return full untouched restaurant objects instead of slim summaries.

channelId.description: Optional Olo channel (brand) id to narrow this cross-brand search to a single brand, sent as the `Channel-Id` header. OMIT it (the normal case) to span all Olo App–enabled brands; pass it only to restrict to one brand. Must be the NUMERIC channel id (e.g. 8), not a channel GUID.

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: UCP: search the product catalog. Requires meta["ucp-agent"].profile and a catalog object. Network-wide: catalog.query (e.g. "burrito") + a location (catalog.location string or catalog.latitude/longitude) searches restaurants near there and returns their matching products. Single restaurant: catalog.restaurant_id browses that menu (query optional). Cursor pagination via catalog.cursor/catalog.limit (default 10). Ids from a restaurant_id menu browse are cartable — usable as checkout line_items[].item.id at that restaurant. Ids from a network query (query + location) are CHAIN-level, for discovery only, and are NOT cartable: to order, re-query with catalog.restaurant_id (a matched restaurant's id) to get that menu's orderable ids.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: UCP: get a single catalog product with its option groups (modifiers). catalog.ids[0] is the product id; supply catalog.restaurant_id to resolve the product's title and price from the restaurant's menu (without it, only option groups are returned — Olo menus own pricing). catalog.selected lists chosen option ids; each is expanded with its nested (cascading) modifier groups under selected_options. Requires meta["ucp-agent"].profile.

tools.name: create_cart
tools.description: UCP: create a shopping cart at a restaurant (pre-checkout basket building). Requires meta["ucp-agent"].profile and a cart object with line_items (item.id = product id) plus a restaurant id (cart.context.restaurant_id or top-level restaurantId). Convert to a checkout later by passing this cart's id as cart_id to create_checkout. Returns the UCP cart.

tools.name: update_checkout
tools.description: UCP: update a checkout session (full replacement). line_items become the exact new set (products are added, re-quantified, or removed to match). fulfillment.handoff_mode sets pickup/curbside/dinein/drivethru; fulfillment.delivery_address (street_address, city, state, zip + handoff_mode delivery/dispatch) sets delivery. fulfillment.time_wanted ({year,month,day,hour,minute} or "asap") schedules the order — a rejected time returns a recoverable error listing up to 10 bookable slots within ±2h of the requested time to retry with (best-effort; the list is omitted if the slot lookup itself fails). buyer is held for complete_checkout. The updated session is validated against the restaurant POS when it has items and a handoff mode — ready_for_complete means submit will be accepted. Returns the updated UCP checkout.

tools.name: complete_checkout
tools.description: UCP: complete a checkout session — PLACES A REAL ORDER and charges the payment credential. Requires meta["ucp-agent"].profile AND meta["idempotency-key"] (UUID; replays return the recorded result). instrument.handler_id picks the payment lane: "olo_token" (default — opaque card network token or a payment_session credential), "olo_pay" (Stripe payment method, credential.type "stripe_payment_method", token "pm_..."), or "google_pay" (Google Pay ECv2 payload, when advertised). Card credentials must carry credential.expiry_year, credential.expiry_month, a postal code (credential.postal_code or billing_address.postal_code), and display.last_digits. Apple Pay and Stripe shared payment tokens are not supported. Payloads carrying raw card data (a PAN) are rejected as protocol errors, not business results. Buyer identity comes from the buyer staged via create/update_checkout or a buyer object on this call (first_name, last_name, email, phone_number — phone as 11 digits). Returns the completed UCP checkout with the order id.

tools.name: cancel_checkout
tools.description: UCP: cancel an open (un-completed) checkout session. Requires meta["ucp-agent"].profile AND meta["idempotency-key"] (UUID). The session is soft-canceled — Olo has no basket delete; the basket simply expires server-side. A completed checkout is terminal: to cancel the placed order, use cancel_order with the order id from complete_checkout's order.id. Returns the canceled UCP checkout.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: UCP: fetch a placed order by id (the order.id from complete_checkout). Requires meta["ucp-agent"].profile. Returns the UCP order: line items with status, fulfillment expectations (method/ready time/location) and events (the tracking log), and totals. Optionally pass checkout_id to stamp the originating checkout when known.

tools.name: notify_order_arrival
tools.description: Notify the restaurant that the customer has ARRIVED to pick up a placed order, by its Olo order GUID (from complete_checkout / get_order). This is the curbside/pickup "I'm here" signal. Optionally include a short message (vehicle make/color, parking spot, etc.). The vendor must support arrival notifications or the call is rejected. Returns the updated order status, whose arrivalstatus reflects the notification.

orderId.description: Olo order GUID the customer has arrived for.

message.description: Optional note for the restaurant (max 128 chars), e.g. "Red Honda Civic, spot 4".

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: CANCEL a placed order by its Olo order GUID (from complete_checkout / get_order). This WRITES: it requests cancellation of a real order. Whether cancellation is allowed depends on how far the order has progressed at the restaurant; the API rejects with an error if it is too late. Returns the updated order status on success. Not idempotent — do not retry blindly; confirm with get_order instead.
